first.rationale: Current situation shows simultaneous declines in activation (6% QoQ) and onboarding completion (4% QoQ), with competitive pressure on price-sensitive segments. Memory_91 demonstrates activation messaging lifted week-one engagement durably. Memory_86 shows onboarding simplification improved adoption. Promotional pricing (memory_73) is contraindicated due to documented 30-day retention damage and our primary objective of sustainable long-term revenue. Referral incentives work well for established customers (memory_57) but won't address current activation decline. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is valuable but doesn't address the SMB activation drop. Activation messaging targets the immediate measurable problem (6% decline) without the retention risk of promotional pricing, and leverages proven learnings. Verifying memory_86 and memory_91 to confirm magnitude of prior lifts and identify whether combined messaging + simplified flow might address both metrics simultaneously.
